coverageContext: Complete 31-variant free-thyroxine (FT4) research score using adult-GWAS coefficients, evaluated in 7231 European-ancestry children from Generation R, ALSPAC and BLTS (median ages6.0,7.5 and12.1years). Reported explained FT4 variation differed across cohorts (1.5%-4.2%); age-dependent effects and this pediatric evaluation do not establish adult or neonatal full-score prediction. The primary models adjusted for age, sex and four ancestry principal components although Catalog covariates are blank. GA retains the unstandardized genetic sum, not a measured hormone concentration, laboratory reference interval, thyroid diagnosis, neonatal screen or levothyroxine dose. Cross-trait associations with TSH/FT3 are not additional validated scores or personal laboratory predictions.
